{{Quote|Scans have indicated minimal power: no life forms, and there doesn't even seem to be much in the way of powered-up droids. The base is deserted.|Suubrin, on the abandoned Confederacy of Independent Systems base|<ref name="Destruction" />}}
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Suubrin''' was a [[Navy/Legends|naval]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] who commanded the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] [[Vigilance (light cruiser)|''Vigilance'']] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Suubrin led an [[Destruction|intelligence-gathering mission]] to raid an [[abandoned Separatist base]] located in a [[LFA-509 system/Legends|featureless star system]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You specialists, some engineers and some marines will be shuttled down to the surface. Half the marines will go with the engineers to power the place up and determine its status. The other half will proceed to the command center with the specialists, to secure any available data.|Suubrin, on the mission plan for investigating the abandoned Confederacy of Independent Systems base|<ref name="Destruction" />}}
Suubrin was an individual who served as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|naval forces]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]&mdash;a tumultuous conflict fought between the Republic and the separatist [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]&mdash;as the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Light cruiser/Legends|light cruiser]] [[Vigilance (light cruiser)|''Vigilance'']]. Suubrin accompanied the ''Vigilance'' on an assignment to [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]]<ref name="Destruction" /> in [[Thaere sector/Legends|Thaere sector]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> where the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] was among a force of Republic [[Starship/Legends|vessels]] posted in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]].<ref name="Destruction" />

Around [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="19 BBY">[[Heart of Evil: Destruction|''Destruction'']] is set shortly before ''[[Heart of Evil: A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance|A Hero Seeks Not Vengeance]]'', a [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure that occurs concurrently with the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle is dated to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', the events of ''Destruction'' can be placed in circa 19 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> Suubrin and the ''Vigilance'' were instructed to assist the [[Cularin Militia|Cularin Armed Forces]], a [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] [[Star system/Legends|system]]-based Republic [[Army/Legends|military force]], on an [[Destruction|intelligence-gathering mission]] to an [[abandoned Separatist base]] that was a suspected stronghold of the [[Believers]] [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]]. The ''Vigilance'' was given overall command of the small Cularin Armed Forces [[Flotilla/Legends|flotilla]] [[Task Group Destruction]] that was assembled for the venture and accompanied the formation to a featureless star system in which the abandoned facility was situated. Upon arrival in the system, Suubrin's forces scanned the base and reported to the captain that the installation was deserted, with no life signs or significant [[Droid/Legends|droid]] activity detected. Based on these readings, Suubrin suspected that the investigation of the base would likely fail to yield any useful strategic information.<ref name="Destruction" />

[[File:Ki-Adi-Mundi_SWFB.png|thumb|left|200px|Ki-Adi-Mundi, the Cerean Jedi Master encountered by Suubrin]]
Despite having misgivings about the prospects of success, Suubrin gave orders for ground forces, consisting of a unit of [[clone marine]]s, four [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] and the [[heroes of Cularin]], a team of independent specialist agents, to be [[Transport/Legends|transported]] to the abandoned base. The captain commanded that the engineers and half of the marines were to bring the facility's power back on line while the specialist agents and the remaining marines were to proceed to the installation's command center and recover any available data. Suubrin personally appraised the [[Soldier/Legends|troops]] of the mission plan and advised that they take care to avoid any traps or [[Mine/Legends|mines]] left behind by the Separatists. The specialist agents subsequently recollected their briefing with the captain while being [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttled]] to the Separatist facility.<ref name="Destruction" />

While Suubrin's forces raided the base, the ''Vigilance'' detected the nearby presence of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was wounded from an encounter with the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] and after receiving medical treatment aboard the ''Vigilance'', Mundi met with Suubrin on the vessel's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]], inside the captain's briefing room. When the heroes of Cularin returned to the ''Vigilance'' from the Separatist base, Suubrin informed them of the Jedi Master's arrival and introduced the agents to the Cerean.<ref name="Destruction" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suubrin featured in [[Heart of Evil: Destruction|''Destruction'']], a [[2005]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Ronald A. Heintz]] that formed part of the [[Heart of Evil trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. The adventure does not specify Suubrin's [[Gender/Legends|gender]] or [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Destruction" />
